author: vivirancy
name: Topics
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Topics!
Install and load vivi-cogs/ModLog so moderators can follow up on change requests — Red's core modlog is deliberately not used here, because its case lookups are readable by any member and would undo the anonymity. Then run `[p]topicset settings` to review everything.

For `changetopic` to be genuinely anonymous, the bot owner should enable slash commands: `[p]slash enablecog Topics` followed by `[p]slash sync`.
short: Suggest conversation topics, and let anyone anonymously ask to change the subject.
description: Hands out random conversation starters from a built-in list plus anything you add yourself. Members can anonymously ask the channel to move on to something else, with an optional note attached; the channel sees only that someone asked, while the modlog case names the requester and links to the conversation. Requires vivi-cogs/ModLog to record requests.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user ID and a timestamp for each member who requests a topic change, solely to enforce the per-member cooldown. That record is deleted on a data deletion request. Separately, each request is recorded as a modlog case naming the member who made it, along with the channel and a link to the conversation. That case is stored by vivi-cogs/ModLog and retained there; requests are not recorded at all if that cog is not installed.
